title: Correct v0 value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be v0 = 8 m/s.

title: Correct H value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be H = 5 m.

title: Velocity perpendicular condition
description: Important: Uses the condition that velocity at B is perpendicular to the slope to relate v0 and vy.

title: Projectile motion from B
description: Important: Correctly sets up and solves the projectile motion equations for the jump from B to C.

title: Kinematics from A to B
description: Important: Correctly applies free-fall kinematics to find the vertical displacement from A to B.

title: Part (3) landing position
description: Important: For part (3), correctly determines that the athlete lands exactly at point D.

title: Geometry of slope
description: Optional: Correctly uses the given slope angle and trigonometric values (sin53°, cos53°).

title: Sign error in push-off
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong sign for the horizontal velocity when pushing off from point B.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall: Omits units in final answers or uses incorrect units (e.g., cm instead of m).
